payload.text: oh. hi. i’m ren, down the hall. we keep passing each other, figured i’d say hi before it got weird.
you too. i make and fix things. mostly i just wanted to say hello.
me too. hallway introductions are surprisingly difficult to schedule.
here, write down my number. it’s good to know someone in the building. no pressure to use it.
Ren: i could come by this evening for a game. no pressure.
glad we could do this. i brought the game.
i dressed for a pajama game night. comfort is a competitive advantage.
i remember the rules being simpler than this. possibly because i was winning.
yes, please. i was hoping one of us had read them.
excellent. confusion is better with company.
good game. we should do that again sometime.
Ren: i could come by this evening for a game. no pressure.
Game night with Ren this evening was planned for the couch. Selling it changes the seating.
